newsitem.title: USA: Consumers Power in 8 wholesale agreements.
newsitem.headline: Consumers Power in 8 wholesale agreements.

text.p: Consumers Power Co, the principal subsidiary of CMS Energy Corp, said Friday it filed eight long-term wholesale power sales agreements with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.
The filing brings to conclusion negotiations with eight municipal and cooperative electric utilities represented by the Michigan Public Power Rate Payers Association.
The contracts are for five years each, beginning in January 1997, Consumers Power said.

Wholesale customers represented in the filings are the cities of Bay City, Eaton Rapids, Hart, Portland, and St. Louis, all in Michigan; the village of Chelsea, Mich.; Southeastern Michigan Rural Electric Cooperative and Wolverine Power Supply Cooperative Inc of Michigan.
The contracts run through 2001 and replace existing seven-year contracts that expire December 31, 1996.
Annual sales to the wholesale customers are estimated at 403,300 megawatt-hours in 1997.
